verdict.line: You lose when Darius pulls you into his E (Apprehend) and stacks Hemorrhage to 5 before R (Noxian Guillotine); you win when you play around Hallowed Mist and kite his cooldowns.

brief.thesis: Darius's entire kill threat is built on stacking Hemorrhage to 5 stacks and then executing with R (Noxian Guillotine), which deals more true damage the more stacks are on you. Gwen's W (Hallowed Mist) directly counters his whole game plan since only enemies who physically enter the mist can target her, so this matchup is decided by whether you place mist before his E (Apprehend) lands, not by raw stats. The 49.8% win rate over 556 games and the 'defensive, Darius has solo-kill advantage' read both point to the same thing: respect his all-in windows, punish everything else.

theirWindow.when: E (Apprehend) up and you're outside mist
theirWindow.what: Darius wants to land his 535-range hook then chain Q (Decimate) and autos to stack Hemorrhage fast; if he pulls you before you've dropped W, disengage immediately rather than trading through it.

yourWindow.what: Apprehend is 26/23.5/21/18.5/16s on cooldown — with no pull available he can't punish your dash, so use E (Skip 'n Slash) to engage, land Q (Snip Snip!) snips, and disengage before it comes back up.

start.item: Doran's Ring + Health Potion + Health Potion
start.why: The 50.9% win rate start over 619 games; the extra sustain matters directly against Darius's Hemorrhage bleed chipping your HP in every trade.

boots.why: 51.7% win rate over 267 games and the higher pick rate (40.3%) reflect that Darius's damage is almost entirely physical autos and Q (Decimate) — the flat reduction blunts his stacking Hemorrhage combo.

core.why: First item in the highest-win-rate path (60.4% over 106 games); gives the early power spike you need before level 9.
Second item on the same 60.4% path, adds burst that helps you punish his E (Apprehend) cooldown windows.
Completes the 24.4%-pick core path and scales your passive's percent-health damage for the mid-to-late-game trades.

runes.keystoneWhy: The 42.5%-win-rate, 30.5%-pick page runs Conqueror because it rewards the extended skirmishes this lane produces — stacks build through your Q (Snip Snip!) snips and the healing offsets Hemorrhage's bleed.

summoners.why: Flash+Ignite is the standard pick at 70.3% with a 49.9% win rate — Ignite lets you close out short trade windows once his Q (Decimate) sustain is on cooldown, and Flash covers you if you misjudge his E (Apprehend) range.

playing.title: Pre-place W before his E lands
playing.detail: Hallowed Mist only lets enemies who enter it target you, so drop it as he closes distance rather than after he's already hooked you — timed early it denies the pull outright.

playing.title: Track your own Hemorrhage stacks
playing.detail: At 5 stacks Darius enrages with massive bonus AD and R (Noxian Guillotine) deals far more true damage — disengage before you hit max stacks, especially once he's level 6.

playing.title: Snip from max range
playing.detail: Q (Snip Snip!) is a 450-range cone landing up to 6 snips while his Q (Decimate) needs him adjacent to you — walk backward while snipping to deny his sustain.

playing.title: Engage only when his E is down
playing.detail: Apprehend is 26/23.5/21/18.5/16s cooldown; without it he has no way to punish your E (Skip 'n Slash) dash, so that's your window to all-in.

playing.title: Respect level 6 all-in range
playing.detail: Noxian Guillotine has 460 range and refreshes its cooldown on a kill — don't sit at high Hemorrhage stacks near his leap distance once he hits 6.

playing.title: Trade short, not long
playing.detail: Your passive A Thousand Cuts deals bonus magic damage based on his current health and heals you off it — short poke exchanges favor your sustain over a drawn-out Q (Decimate) brawl.

playing.title: Punish his W cast
playing.detail: Crippling Strike is only a 5s cooldown but telegraphs his next attack as a slow — back off after he uses it rather than trading through the slow into a Hemorrhage stack.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, runes, summoners, and win rates above are measured from live games on the current patch (16.18.1) via OP.GG; the mechanical reasoning, timings, and trade patterns are my own tactical read, not measured data.
